explication: Autoresearch is a single-GPU autonomous LLM pretraining loop. An AI research agent reads the instructions, prepares data and a tokenizer once, edits `train.py`, runs a fixed five-minute experiment, evaluates validation bits-per-byte, and keeps or discards the change. The repository implements preparation, batching, GPT modeling, optimization, training, and evaluation; the autonomous orchestration and experiment history are described by the README rather than sampled implementation.
